title: A black crack of noise in the street here
html_source: Earlier in the book (Chapter 9) Stephen describes God as a “noise in the street”. Now, there’s thunder outside (“a black crack of noise in the street here… Loud on left Thor thundered”) that makes Stephen believe God is angry at him. His description of God literally manifests itself. Later on in this early 17th century-esque passage, Bloom tries to comfort Stephen by explaining the science behind lightning to him
